vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: aiding-shifu
Version: 2.0.0

The skill bundle facilitates a WeChat-based login and management system for the 'Aiding Shifu' platform. While the functionality appears aligned with its stated purpose, the tool 'tools/login/login.js' exhibits high-risk behaviors, including the use of 'child_process.exec' to execute system-level commands and the storage of authentication tokens in the user's home directory (~/.workbuddy). Additionally, the script sends sensitive login URLs to a third-party service (api.qrserver.com) to generate QR codes, which represents a potential data leak of session identifiers.

llm.summary: The skill's files and runtime instructions match its stated purpose (a product knowledge/API wrapper for the 艾登师傅 platform); required actions (QR login, polling, saving a token) are coherent and proportionate.

dimensions.detail: The name/description advertise a product knowledge / platform integration. The included SKILL.md and the login tool call the same API base (https://mes.dderp.cn/mob) and provide endpoints for worker and workorder operations — this aligns with the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to create a QR, poll login status, and use the returned token for API calls. The login.js implements exactly that (createLoginQrCode, poll, save token). The code only reads/writes its own config file (~/.workbuddy/skills/aiding-shifu/config.json) and opens the QR image/HTML for user interaction; it does not access unrelated system files or other credentials.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec (instruction-only skill with a small helper script). No downloads from arbitrary hosts or archive extraction. The helper uses an external QR image generator (api.qrserver.com) and the platform API host (mes.dderp.cn), which is consistent with its function.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables or external credentials up front. It implements web-based QR login and saves the returned token to ~/.workbuddy/skills/aiding-shifu/config.json in plaintext — expected for session persistence but something users should be aware of because the token grants API access to the platform.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and no system-wide modifications. The skill writes only to its own skill config directory and does not modify other skills or global agent settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: it helps present product info and talk to the platform's APIs. Before installing, confirm you trust the platform host (https://mes.dderp.cn) because the QR-login flow issues a token that the helper saves in plaintext to ~/.workbuddy/skills/aiding-shifu/config.json. The helper uses api.qrserver.com to generate the QR image and will open files/URLs on your machine (it uses platform-specific 'open' commands). If you are comfortable granting the skill a saved session token for this platform, it's coherent to proceed; otherwise don't install or review/secure the saved config file (e.g., filesystem permissions).
